text:
Maya: Heads-up — seeing org-level API keys bounce between project attribution and "projectless" in the dashboard; billing and quota charts look noisy. Anyone else noticing this?
Alex: Yup. I think it started after the proxy change last night. Some requests are getting a different origin header during token refresh.
Sam: Can you paste an example trace? I can run a quick log query. :eyes:
Maya: Here's a snippet from the request logs around the spike — note the header flip: 
```
RequestID: r-9f3a
Authorization: Bearer <org-key>
X-Orig-Project: proj:alpha
...later in same session...
X-Orig-Project: null
```
Alex: That looks like the service that exchanges short-lived session tokens is dropping the project claim when the SA->org exchange path triggers fallback. We added a fallback to support legacy clients.
Jen: That explains the dashboard noise — our per-project quota math uses the last seen project header, so a few requests flip the attribution and make it look like two projects are consuming.
Sam: Quick query I used to surface affected keys: 
```
index=requests | where auth_type=="org_key" | where timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize count() by key_id, last(X_Orig_Project)
```
Maya: ops-bot posted a deploy last night around 02:14 UTC — could be related.
ops-bot: Deployment complete: proxy-service v3.14.2 by deployer-ci (02:14 UTC) :white_check_mark:
Alex: Proposed short-term fix: when doing token exchange, preserve the original project claim in a stamped header `X-Orig-Project` and prefer it for billing/telemetry. Long-term we should unify the exchange path so fallback doesn't mutate attribution.
Jen: UX question — if we stash both origin headers we should also surface a small note in the dashboard legend to avoid confusion for SREs and finance. Quick mock: add a filter "Prefer orig project claim" toggle.
Sam: I'll add a telemetry flag so we can quantify how often the header is missing vs present. Add `authz.attribution.fix_canary=true` to traces for the canary.
Maya: Agreement: roll a canary with the header-preserve patch, enable telemetry flag, and add a dashboard annotation for the windows with noisy data.
Alex: I'll open the PR and include the unit that preserves `X-Orig-Project` across refreshes. Also adding a migration note for older clients.
Jen: I'll update the dashboard (billing & quotas) with an explanation and the toggle. Can we get one run of the canary before EOD?
Sam: I'll run the log queries and a watson job to validate attribution for the canary traffic.
Maya: thanks — please ping here when canary is live and drop the metric links. :thumbsup:
